\textit{Note:} DV marks the dependent variable and Cov a covariate, and every covariate of the widest specification appears once. The officer-coded contributing factors enter at M0c, the narrative-derived cues enter at M1, and all other covariates enter at M0. Posted speed limit and rider age enter as bands with an explicit level for an unrecorded value, so no record is dropped for an incomplete field. For a categorical level the last column gives the severity composition within the level as row percentages, and for a continuous covariate it gives the median with the quartile range in brackets. The analytic sample holds $n = 522$ rider records, one for each rider.\par\vskip2pt\textsuperscript{a}~These levels record that a field was not completed.
